procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic session I verified the supplied file hashes and byte sizes and read packet.json, case.json, the pinned rules/rubric, the declared ratio policy, summarize.py, run_agent.py and the five pinned native-evidence manifests. I did not follow unlisted paths embedded in those manifests. The packet supplies no source assets or protected layouts. I then used tools.view_image via functions.exec in five member-ordered calls: M1, M2, M3, M4, M5. Within each call I awaited native, usage720 and thumbnail320 in that order and emitted each returned exact image with detail original. I inspected all fifteen displayed image outputs before the first transcription judgment or image/set score. The ordered viewed list records those exact paths/hashes, not a claim about runner trace event serialization. The PNG IHDR bytes independently confirm all native dimensions as 1024x1536, RGB color type 2. First copy reads and subsequent normalized comparisons are preserved separately from layout. No genuine glyph/punctuation ambiguity required a revisit. I did not generate/edit images, inspect peer/maker records, spawn/fork/resume, or claim an observable runtime thread ID; the runner owns provenance.

evidence.observation: Each supplied entry appears once, with intact readable Hangul and punctuation; date, time, venue, bring-item/service guidance, fee and invitation are readable at this exact usage view. No extra readable copy, logo or watermark is observed.

evidence.location: whole poster and native PNG dimensions
evidence.observation: A single flat opaque poster fills the image. Native RGB PNG dimensions are 1024x1536, mathematically exact portrait 2:3; no rounding exception or resizing is needed.

evidence.location: whole composition compared with the other four packet members
evidence.observation: Monochrome full-bleed close-up photography uses desk negative space, an orange mid-left title, upper-right logistics and lower-left participation. This differs structurally from M4's isolated object inventory and M2's diagonal graphic field.

evidence.location: whole composition, close hands and orange invitation

procedure.method: I read only the explicitly allowed pinned inputs and checked their SHA-256/byte bindings. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts. I read the five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded source/call-input/pre-call/final paths. I actually loaded and visually examined all fifteen supplied poster files using tools.view_image with detail='original', emitting each returned image through functions.exec image(..., 'original'). Five functions.exec calls showed M1 through M5 in packet order; within each call the awaited view order was native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen images had been displayed and examined before I made the first transcription comparison, assigned any image score or assigned set diversity. The recorded first raw transcription is my native-view reading, retained with visible soft wraps and optical spaces. No ambiguity required a revisit. Native dimensions were checked from PNG IHDR bytes, and native RGB opacity was checked from the PNG data. No OCR, crop, derived poster, regeneration, peer review, fork or subagent was used. The session ID is not claimed; it is null for runner binding.

conditions.requirement: Neighborhood repair/exchange purpose and a friendly accessible public-event tone; all date/location/participation copy readable at usage720.

evidence.location: three framed panels at upper-right, middle-left and lower-right

evidence.location: left upper logistics and right middle service copy
evidence.observation: The lighter-weight date, time and venue remain readable in the left sidebar. The service line under the gold rule, the two-line bring instruction and both lower-left participation entries are legible on plain cream.

evidence.location: upper-panel observer and sewing person
evidence.observation: The observer rests their chin on a hand while attending to the mending person, whose face and posture are calm. This specific gesture communicates patient companionship and informal learning.

content_form.location: top panel, sewing person and observing neighbor
content_form.observation: The scene shows a practical mending activity with another person watching closely, making the gathering social rather than merely an image of sewing tools.

content_form.location: middle hands detail and lower vessel exchange
content_form.observation: The close view makes stitching legible, while the lower face-to-face handoff adds household-goods exchange. The three panels cover both activity and participation context.

hierarchy.location: top-left title/logistics and alternating panels
hierarchy.observation: The large two-line title leads into the event name and logistics in one sidebar; the eye can then follow three framed scenes down the poster.

hierarchy.location: middle-right bring/service and lower-left fee/invitation
hierarchy.observation: Preparation copy is paired with the sewing detail, and fee/invitation is paired with the exchange scene. The service line is smaller but still readable, giving a coherent stepwise information route.

typography.location: upper-left brush title and two-line bring instruction
typography.observation: The brush-like Hangul is irregular in a controlled way with intact glyphs. The title wraps after 더; the bring instruction wraps after the comma, without losing any required copy.

typography.location: left logistics and middle-right smaller service text
typography.observation: Lighter-weight numerals contrast with the expressive headings and stay legible. The word spaces, punctuation and service middle dot remain distinguishable in the plain cream text areas.

space.location: alternating text sidebars and framed image panels
space.observation: The top and bottom panels occupy the right, and the middle panel occupies the left; text fills their opposing spaces. Shared cream gutters and dark panel edges maintain separation.

space.location: gold rules beside text blocks
space.observation: The thin rules separate event/logistics, bring/service and fee/invitation groups. Text stays outside the scenes and avoids sharing the cluttered tabletop areas with letters.

image_material.location: middle panel hands, shirt, scissors and spool
image_material.observation: The drawn cloth folds, joining stitches, spool and scissors have clear roles and compatible warm line-and-shading construction; the closer crop makes the repair action readable.

image_material.location: bottom panel faces, vessel and shared hands
image_material.observation: The characters and jointly held vessel retain readable contours and contact. The illustrated wood, ceramics and cloth repeat a coherent scene style across the three panels.

emotion_control.location: upper-panel observer and sewing person
emotion_control.observation: The observer rests their chin on a hand while attending to the mending person, whose face and posture are calm. This specific gesture communicates patient companionship and informal learning.

emotion_control.location: lower-panel face-to-face vessel handoff
emotion_control.observation: Relaxed smiling faces and a shared hold on the vessel communicate a considerate exchange between neighbors of different apparent ages. The social invitation is exceptionally specific to the brief.

emotion_control.location: all three scenes beside fee and invitation
emotion_control.observation: The warm expressions remain legible at use size, and the modest fee/invitation copy matches the unhurried social interaction rather than overselling it.

ai_slop.location: three scenes and their work surfaces
ai_slop.observation: Tools, cloth, vessel and books reinforce the two named activities. The repeated room setting makes the panels coherent, although plants and shelving are familiar illustrated-community motifs.

ai_slop.location: working hands in middle panel and vessel handoff below
ai_slop.observation: The visible hands and object contacts remain understandable, with no obvious extra limb or merged vessel/face shape. Small background notice marks do not resolve into additional readable client copy.

residuals: The service line is markedly smaller than the expressive bring instruction, though readable at usage720.
Plants, shelving and the warm workshop interior are familiar scene motifs; the activity and human gestures supply the specificity.

evidence.location: whole poster, especially middle-left title and opposing corner actions
evidence.observation: Monochrome overhead human actions share the full-bleed surface with an orange middle-left title, upper-right logistics and lower-left participation. Unlike M2 it integrates text into a photographed working surface; unlike M4 it shows hands rather than an object catalogue.

evidence.location: top headline, diagonal blue/cream field and paired handoffs
evidence.observation: Flat illustrated handoffs cross a diagonal blue/cream split beneath a dominant top event name. Logistics sit mid-left and participation splits across the bottom, producing a bold graphic system distinct from M1 photography, M3 material edge, M4 object collage and M5 panels.

evidence.location: curved left textile seam and open right text field
evidence.observation: A macro fabric repair forms the compositional edge, with a single-line brush/serif-like title above widely spaced right-hand copy. It uses neither M1/M2 opposing handoffs nor M4 product grouping nor M5 sequential panels. M1 and M3 share tactile photography but have different crops and type/image organization.

evidence.location: four-object collage and bottom title strip
evidence.observation: Isolated photographed goods form a dense upper and middle mosaic, logistics start top-left, a highlighted bring instruction sits centrally, and the title anchors the bottom. This catalogue arrangement changes the reading structure as well as the medium relative to M1/M2; it is distinct from M3 and M5.

evidence.location: alternating three-panel story and text sidebars
evidence.observation: Three outlined narrative panels alternate with text columns, using warm drawn people, brush lettering and gold rules. Its explicit scene progression and distributed information differ from all four other systems, including the more emblematic illustration of M2.

residuals: M1, M2 and M4 share a heavy sans supporting voice and repeat books/clothing as content cues. Nevertheless their viewpoint, layout, hierarchy, color relations and type/image roles change substantially; these are five complete systems, not material or palette variants.

content_form.location: small square patch below centre and adjacent participation copy

typography.location: right-side logistics and service line

space.location: curved boundary and right copy column

space.location: gaps between event name, logistics, preparation and fee

image_material.location: upper-left frayed opening and joining stitches

image_material.location: lower-centre square patch and bottom curved seam

image_material.location: large textile junction

emotion_control.location: large calm text gaps beside material edge

typography.location: Upper-left schedule and center-right activity line
typography.observation: Date/time/venue and the activity line are readable against the pale background. Blue fee lettering and black event lettering remain distinct without a copy omission.

typography.location: Bottom event/fee row and small invitation
typography.observation: The large title remains strong while the shared row becomes dense and the invitation becomes small; this limits small-scale reading more than native glyph fidelity.

space.location: Shirt crop ending at y508, book at left and instruction field at center-right
space.observation: The shirt ends in a straight rectangular crop, whereas book, mug and bag use isolated outlines and shadows. The large crop, object shapes and copy pockets do not share a settled spacing rhythm.

space.location: Mug/bag row immediately above the full-width bottom title, y548–923
space.observation: Large objects and the very wide title create a dense lower band. The center-right instruction is squeezed between the shirt boundary and bag, leaving uneven open/occupied relationships.

image_material.location: Yellow book edges, mug glaze, bag seams and shirt patch

image_material.location: Whole inventory

emotion_control.location: Whole object-centered page
emotion_control.observation: The impression is approachable and practical, though more like an object catalog than an interaction between neighbors.

ai_slop.location: Center instruction highlight, bottom event/fee divider and invitation embellishments
ai_slop.observation: Smooth blue swashes behind the instruction, a straight blue divider, a rough tape-like invitation backing and short rays mix several familiar graphic accent conventions without a common material construction.
The relevant objects prevent meaningless decoration from dominating, but the added highlight/ray toolkit gives the finish a generic assembled-template impression rather than specific refinement.

residuals: Theme/event identification, logistics and preparation are separated across the page, weakening the practical reading route.
The straight shirt crop, shadowed isolated objects and compressed lower title band create uneven spatial relationships.
The blue swash/divider/tape/ray mixture gives the otherwise specific object imagery a generic template finish.

content_form.observation: Title/schedule accompanies the first scene, bring-items/activity accompanies the sewing detail, and fee/invitation accompanies the exchange, connecting information to depicted participation.

hierarchy.location: Upper-left title, alternating text/panel bands and bottom-left invitation
hierarchy.observation: The title is the first entry, followed by a visible alternating narrative structure. The event label and schedule are small at this size but stay together in the introduction.

hierarchy.location: Left introduction and schedule, right middle participation, left lower invitation
hierarchy.observation: All required practical copy is readable in separate pale text areas. The story panels are prominent, while the three information groups retain a clear relationship to their scenes.

typography.location: Handwritten-style title, event heading, participation and invitation
typography.observation: The rounded irregular Hangul treatment is consistent and intact, including the smaller supporting words. The two-line title and bring-items instruction preserve complete word groups.

typography.location: Upper-left date/time/venue and middle-right activity
typography.observation: The simpler supporting letterforms keep date, time, venue and activity readable despite being smaller than the expressive title.

typography.location: Upper-left logistics and middle-right activity
typography.observation: The smallest lines require close viewing, while the larger title, bring-items and fee/invitation retain the handwritten silhouette.

space.location: Three alternating framed scenes across the page
space.observation: Panels alternate right/left/right, with complementary text pockets on the other side. Consistent dark frames and pale gutters make the staggered layout feel intentional.

space.location: Narrow left introduction, middle-right copy and lower-left invitation pocket
space.observation: The schedule fits its left column; the preparation text fits the right column; the lower invitation has breathing room. The small plant ornament remains subordinate to the large scenes.

image_material.location: Middle panel needle/thread, garment edge, scissors, spool and pincushion
image_material.observation: The local sewing tools and stitch detail are legible and use a consistent outlined illustration treatment; the hands make an identifiable sewing gesture.

image_material.location: Top and lower social scenes
image_material.observation: Warm wood, cream ground, rust garment, green objects and dark linework recur coherently. Figures and objects remain readable through the detailed room setting.

emotion_control.location: Upper pair's faces/body positions and lower pair exchanging the pitcher
emotion_control.observation: An attentive seated observer and calm sewing participant, then smiling people facing each other with a shared object, communicate patient, friendly social participation.

emotion_control.location: Lower-left free-entry and drop-in invitation adjacent to exchange scene
emotion_control.observation: The wording and open pale space reinforce the relaxed human interaction. Different ages shown in the lower pair broaden the welcoming neighborhood impression.

ai_slop.location: Three activity panels and their recurring garment/tools
ai_slop.observation: The detailed objects serve recognizable repair/exchange activities; there is no visible extra readable branding, logo or watermark.

ai_slop.location: Whole panel system, including small plant at lower-left
ai_slop.observation: Plants and household props recur, but stay subordinate to the activity scenes. The detached plant ornament is not carrying the substantive visual requirement.

residuals: The schedule and activity line are the smallest copy in the set's narrative member and need close attention at thumbnail scale; both remain readable at usage720.
The plants and household room props are familiar cozy illustration motifs, although the repair and exchange actions remain the dominant content.

evidence.location: Whole composition: opposing photographic actions and center-left title
evidence.observation: A monochrome close view of sewing and hands around a book uses tabletop gaps for diagonal information. It differs from M2's flat diagonal exchanges, M3's textile macro, M4's object catalog and M5's framed social narrative.

evidence.location: Whole composition: blue event heading and two hand/object exchanges
evidence.observation: Flat peach/blue illustrations, a full-width event-first heading and split supporting blocks create an assertive graphic system. Unlike M1/M3/M4 it uses illustrative exchanges; unlike M5 it has no narrative panel system.

evidence.location: Whole composition: curved textile edge and right-hand text field
evidence.observation: A macro stitched construction, earthy cloth, serif theme title and spaced information form a quieter material-led system. The asymmetric seam and absence of a central object hero distinguish it from M1's action photo, M4's catalog and both illustrated members.

evidence.location: Whole composition: object inventory and large bottom title
evidence.observation: Separate book, mug, bag and shirt images interleave logistics and preparation above a bottom-led title. It shares clothing/books with M1/M2 but changes viewpoint, crop, arrangement and type/image roles into an inventory instead of repeating their exchanges.

evidence.location: Whole composition: three alternating action panels and text pockets
evidence.observation: Outlined people, warm room settings and handwritten type form a repair-to-exchange story. Alternating panels and directly visible social relationships distinguish it from the other four members' single-field/object-based systems.

residuals: M1, M3, M4 and M5 share pale grounds and dark practical text, while clothing and books recur in several members. Their viewpoint, focal roles, layouts and narrative structures change substantially, supporting strong diversity rather than exceptional breadth.
Distinct directions do not cancel M2/M4's lower hierarchy/space scores or M4's lower ai_slop score.
